This page is the public index of available reading copies and source collections.

Categories and status labels follow the [Archive Taxonomy](archive-taxonomy.qmd).

## Primary Collections

| Entry | Category | Status | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Foundations](foundations.qmd) | Core Foundation | Foundation | Identifies the diagnostic and embodied foundation documents that govern the archive. |
| [Archive taxonomy](archive-taxonomy.qmd) | Supporting Essay | Working Note | Defines the categories and status labels used by this archive index. |
| [Core concepts](core-concepts.qmd) | Core Foundation | Foundation | Names the recurring vocabulary of logos, embodiment, apostasy, repentance, and redemption. |
| [The Path of Re-Embodiment](path-of-re-embodiment.qmd) | Core Foundation | Foundation | Orders the archive around return from false embodiment into Christ. |
| [The Church and False Embodiment](church.qmd) | Major Essay | Public Essay | Frames the church as loved by Christ while still vulnerable to false institutional embodiment. |
| [Reader's Guide](readers-guide.qmd) | Supporting Essay | Public Essay | Orients different readers toward careful, repentant, non-triumphal engagement. |
| [Method](method.qmd) | Supporting Essay | Public Essay | Explains the project's claim types, typology, analogies, warnings, and limits. |
| [Document Intake Covenant](document-intake-covenant.qmd) | Supporting Essay | Public Essay | Describes how raw material becomes public, canonical, or held in reserve. |
| [Faithful Institutions](faithful-institutions.qmd) | Supporting Essay | Public Essay | Keeps institutional critique ordered toward truthful and restorative forms of common life. |
| [Reading paths](reading-paths.qmd) | Supporting Essay | Public Essay | Offers routes through the archive by theme and reader need. |
| [Essays and drafts](essays.qmd) | Supporting Essay | Public Essay | Groups public essays and adds claim-type reading notes for intense works. |
| [Images and visual theology](images.qmd) | Image | Public Essay | Indexes the public visual-theology gallery and image resources. |
| [Songs](songs.qmd) | Song | Public Essay | Gathers devotional or poetic song material in the public archive. |
| [Discussions](discussions.qmd) | Discussion | Public Essay | Collects public discussion artifacts and conversation-oriented material. |

## Source Collections

| Entry | Category | Status | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `raw/` | Raw Source | Source Material, Needs Review | Preserves original PDFs, drafts, source notes, and held material before public or canonical decisions. |
| `intake/` | Raw Source | Working Note | Temporary staging folder for new documents and images before classification, placement, and site integration. |
| `raw/images/` | Raw Source | Source Material, Working Note | Stores image prompts, OCR records, and source notes behind public gallery assets. |
| `gallery/` | Image | Source Material, Public Essay | Contains public image files used by the Quarto site and gallery pages. |
